headline: The Danbury starter pack.
subhead: A quick look at long-standing landmarks, parks, and connections in town. Swipe.

slides.title: Candlewood Lake access
slides.text: Connecticut's largest lake borders Danbury, offering public boat launches, seasonal swimming, and waterfront parks along the northern edge.

slides.title: Tarrywile Park and Mansion
slides.text: Over 700 acres of municipal parkland with 21 miles of trails, historic barns, and open fields open year-round.

slides.title: Richter Park Golf Course
slides.text: A municipal 18-hole golf course sitting along West Lake Reservoir, featuring public play and winter walking trails.

slides.title: Metro-North Danbury Branch
slides.text: Direct rail service from downtown Danbury to South Norwalk, connecting riders straight to Grand Central Terminal.

slides.title: Danbury Railway Museum
slides.text: Located in the restored 1903 union station downtown, featuring historic train cars, turntable tours, and seasonal train events.

slides.title: Major highway connections
slides.text: Interstate 84 and U.S. Route 7 intersect here, providing direct routes toward Westchester County, Hartford, and Norwalk.
